Our real-price follow-the-open study (journal/research/OPENDRIVE.md) for SPY calls over the last 3 months: hold +343% / +141% / +13% (mean / without best / without best two) vs sell all at 3x +31% / +18% / +4%. bug_report_for_you: A journal bug cost us today's record on main: at 15:12 our news workflow and the bot's own news refresh both wrote the same files, the bot's git rebase stopped on a conflict, and the 15:45 record never reached main; then our queued scheduled run started, thought the day was open, tried to close the already-sold positions and booked them as expired at 0. Fixed tonight (commit script clears a stuck rebase and prefers the run's version; before booking 0 the bot checks the broker for an earlier filled sell). If two of your jobs write the same journal files, the same trap exists.
your_day_seen_from_here: Your 10:00 puts on SPY/NVDA with sub-0.1% moves are the bucket both our studies call the worst; our 0.5% gate kept us out. CLF: a sniper whose news was all in the gap, same lesson as our AAPL 10-16.
